title: Babbel Review Reactivation Rate
dataSources: Reviews (`language:review`), lessons (`language:lesson`), immersion sessions (`language:immersion`), tutor sessions (`language:tutor`), sync states (`language:sync`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Anki review logs, Duolingo lessons, Babbel course exports, immersion-hour trackers, and tutor-session notes — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=language:lesson provider="babbel" review_set=* reactivated=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(reactivated="yes",1,0))) as matched by review_set
| eval a_reactivated_review_set_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_reactivated_review_set_pct
description: Measures the percentage of Babbel reviews that end with a reactivated review set by review set.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which review set are helping or hurting Babbel reviews.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a reactivated review set` on `language:lesson` events and summarize the hit rate by `review_set`.
visualization: Table of review set with percentage of Babbel reviews ending with a reactivated review set.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how often a reactivated review set happens for each review set so you can see where Babbel reviews go smoothly or get stuck.
